title: Mechanisms of Transcriptional Regulation by Salicylic Acid Receptors.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PMID 42749286 returned only related-PubMed links (no GEO/SRA/BioProject). GEO search for NIMIN1/MED15A/NPR4 in 2025-2026 found one unrelated series (GSE290673, Coptis root rot). PDBe search found entry 9ZJN, a cryo-EM structure of the salicylic acid-bound NPR1-MED15 complex (Zhang S, Zheng N; released 2026-07-29; EMD-74329).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the biology (MED15A bridge, NIMIN1-TPL-PRC2 repression, H3K27me3 changes) comes from the abstract only; any ChIP-seq or RNA-seq deposits the paywalled paper may list were not found.

a1_downloadable.note: Only one cryo-EM structure (PDB 9ZJN) is publicly findable; no tabular or genomics dataset linked to the paper was found in Europe PMC, NCBI or GEO. Checked via APIs, not paper text (paywalled).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: A mechanistic paper of protein interactions and a single structure; no measured outcome column exists for a model to predict.

a5_enough_rows.note: One structure plus presumably a handful of assays; nowhere near 400 labelled rows.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: a single PDB entry, a few MB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Trivially small, but there is nothing to model.

honest_claim_h3: No model can be trained here: the public output is one protein-complex structure, not a labelled dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use plant defence gene sequences and chromatin marks to predict which genes salicylic acid switches on through its receptors.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need per-gene chromatin (H3K27me3, acetylation) and expression measurements before and after salicylic acid treatment; number of examples unknown because no such deposit was found.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene is induced by salicylic acid via NPR1 or de-repressed via NPR3/NPR4, measured by RNA-seq or ChIP in the paper's mutants, which are not publicly located.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant immunity researchers could prioritise target genes for crop engineering, but the project is undefined without a deposited genome-wide dataset.

ml_idea: None viable: mechanistic biochemistry/structural paper whose only located public data is a single cryo-EM structure (PDB 9ZJN).

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no dataset to model.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Search GEO/SRA for the paper's ChIP-seq/RNA-seq deposits; none found linked to PMID 42749286 or matching its genes in 2025-2026.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mechanistic plant-immunity paper; the only public data found is one cryo-EM structure (PDB 9ZJN, NPR1-MED15 complex), with no linked GEO/SRA deposits or supplementary tables, so there is no labelled table and nowhere near enough rows (fails A1, A2, A5).
